none: PAS WILT-7C1D86: Roman coin: Radiate of Diocletian
contea di ritrovamento: Wiltshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy Roman radiate of Diocletian struck by Carausius dating to the period c. AD 291-292 (Reece period 14), PAX AVG reverse type depicting Pax standing left holding branch and vertical sceptre. Mint of London, S P//MLXXI. This issue normally has the reverse legend PAX AVGGG. This is only the second specimen of this coin recorded by Sam Moorhead for his corpus for RIC
